description: Repairs r-txn-1b/xproc-uncommitted-membership: the 'as is' reads after A's commit came within about 10 ms, so staleness may be read-cache timing rather than transaction visibility. On r-txn-1b-main-accdb, both processes open the main file shared read/write. a: BeginTrans; INSERT INTO R (ID, V, Z) VALUES (30, 300, 'x30'); DELETE FROM R WHERE ID = 2 (dbFailOnError). b: reads R as is and after DBEngine.Idle(dbRefreshCache). a: Rollback; DBEngine.Errors. b: waits 7 s, reads R as is and after Idle. a: BeginTrans; INSERT INTO R (ID, V, Z) VALUES (31, 310, 'x31'); CommitTrans; DBEngine.Errors. b: waits 7 s, then reads R as is and after Idle.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
